  "cells": [
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "oVGE1gP-z4IF"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from tensorflow.keras.datasets import mnist\n",
        "\n",
        "rng = np.random.default_rng(0)"
      ],
      "id": "oVGE1gP-z4IF"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ep2aLq6bz4IJ"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 1. Data"
      ],
      "id": "ep2aLq6bz4IJ"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "UR9capq3z4IL",
        "outputId": "690c7188-0cc7-4b0e-8941-6b52ffdc9ab8",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Downloading data from https://storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/tf-keras-datasets/mnist.npz\n",
            "\u001b[1m11490434/11490434\u001b[0m \u001b[32m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\u001b[0m\u001b[37m\u001b[0m \u001b[1m0s\u001b[0m 0us/step\n",
            "(60000, 784) (60000, 10) (10000, 784)\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "(x_tr, y_tr), (x_te, y_te) = mnist.load_data()\n",
        "\n",
        "def flatten_scale(x):\n",
        "    return x.reshape(len(x), -1).astype(\"float32\") / 255.0\n",
        "\n",
        "X_tr, X_te = flatten_scale(x_tr), flatten_scale(x_te)\n",
        "Y_tr = np.eye(10, dtype=\"float32\")[y_tr]          # one-hot via identity-matrix indexing\n",
        "print(X_tr.shape, Y_tr.shape, X_te.shape)"
      ],
      "id": "UR9capq3z4IL"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "M39hMpKLz4IM"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 2. Network parameters and helper functions"
      ],
      "id": "M39hMpKLz4IM"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "bEyJwTBlz4IN"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "N_IN, N_HID, N_OUT = 784, 64, 10\n",
        "\n",
        "params = {\n",
        "    \"W1\": rng.normal(0, np.sqrt(2 / N_IN),  (N_IN, N_HID)).astype(\"float32\"),\n",
        "    \"b1\": np.zeros(N_HID, dtype=\"float32\"),\n",
        "    \"W2\": rng.normal(0, np.sqrt(2 / N_HID), (N_HID, N_OUT)).astype(\"float32\"),\n",
        "    \"b2\": np.zeros(N_OUT, dtype=\"float32\"),\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "def relu(z):\n",
        "    return np.maximum(z, 0.0)\n",
        "\n",
        "def softmax(z):\n",
        "    z = z - z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)          # numerical stability\n",
        "    e = np.exp(z)\n",
        "    return e / e.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "def forward(X, p):\n",
        "    h_pre = X @ p[\"W1\"] + p[\"b1\"]\n",
        "    h = relu(h_pre)\n",
        "    probs = softmax(h @ p[\"W2\"] + p[\"b2\"])\n",
        "    return h_pre, h, probs\n",
        "\n",
        "def cross_entropy(Y, probs):\n",
        "    return -np.mean(np.sum(Y * np.log(probs + 1e-9), axis=1))"
      ],
      "id": "bEyJwTBlz4IN"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9ii1O2KOz4IO"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 3. Training loop"
      ],
      "id": "9ii1O2KOz4IO"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "rv0lx42vz4IP",
        "outputId": "0d74de59-a2de-4535-8da1-94da9f7974cb",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "epoch  1  train loss 0.3883  test acc 0.9269\n",
            "epoch  2  train loss 0.2157  test acc 0.9456\n",
            "epoch  3  train loss 0.1674  test acc 0.9554\n",
            "epoch  4  train loss 0.1386  test acc 0.9612\n",
            "epoch  5  train loss 0.1181  test acc 0.9652\n",
            "epoch  6  train loss 0.1035  test acc 0.9665\n",
            "epoch  7  train loss 0.0920  test acc 0.9686\n",
            "epoch  8  train loss 0.0829  test acc 0.9664\n",
            "epoch  9  train loss 0.0758  test acc 0.9702\n",
            "epoch 10  train loss 0.0698  test acc 0.9734\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "EPOCHS, BATCH, LR = 10, 64, 0.1\n",
        "history = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, EPOCHS + 1):\n",
        "    order = rng.permutation(len(X_tr))\n",
        "    epoch_loss = 0.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    for start in range(0, len(order), BATCH):\n",
        "        idx = order[start:start + BATCH]\n",
        "        xb, yb = X_tr[idx], Y_tr[idx]\n",
        "        m = len(idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "        h_pre, h, probs = forward(xb, params)\n",
        "        epoch_loss += cross_entropy(yb, probs) * m\n",
        "\n",
        "        # backward pass\n",
        "        d_logits = (probs - yb) / m\n",
        "        grads = {\n",
        "            \"W2\": h.T @ d_logits,\n",
        "            \"b2\": d_logits.sum(axis=0),\n",
        "        }\n",
        "        d_h = (d_logits @ params[\"W2\"].T) * (h_pre > 0)\n",
        "        grads[\"W1\"] = xb.T @ d_h\n",
        "        grads[\"b1\"] = d_h.sum(axis=0)\n",
        "\n",
        "        for k in params:\n",
        "            params[k] -= LR * grads[k]\n",
        "\n",
        "    history.append(epoch_loss / len(X_tr))\n",
        "    test_acc = (forward(X_te, params)[2].argmax(1) == y_te).mean()\n",
        "    print(f\"epoch {epoch:2d}  train loss {history[-1]:.4f}  test acc {test_acc:.4f}\")"
      ],
      "id": "rv0lx42vz4IP"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hXsa8Gh3z4IR"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 4. Loss curve"
      ],
      "id": "hXsa8Gh3z4IR"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "qXHWbzX4z4IS",

      ],
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))\n",
        "plt.plot(range(1, EPOCHS + 1), history, marker=\"o\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Epoch\"); plt.ylabel(\"Mean cross-entropy\"); plt.title(\"Training loss\")\n",
        "plt.grid(alpha=0.3); plt.show()"
      ],
      "id": "qXHWbzX4z4IS"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",

      ],
      "source": [
        "probs_te = forward(X_te, params)[2]\n",
        "preds = probs_te.argmax(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(10, 4.5))\n",
        "for ax, i in zip(axes.ravel(), rng.choice(len(X_te), 10, replace=False)):\n",
        "    ax.imshow(x_te[i], cmap=\"gray\")\n",
        "    ax.set_title(f\"pred {preds[i]} / true {y_te[i]}\",\n",
        "                 color=\"green\" if preds[i] == y_te[i] else \"red\", fontsize=9)\n",
        "    ax.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()"
      ],
      "id": "yDUyzncdz4IU"
    }
  ]
}
